page.layout: One page of an index in two columns of entries: a running title "INDEX" at the top; section letters B., C., D. set as headings; each entry runs left to right with its page numbers at the right. Catchword "Dio-" at the lower right.
page.notes: Underlined and blue-marked page numbers are as printed in the scan's colouring; the line-initial capital letters B, C, D are decorative woodcut-style initials, joined to their words. Some page numbers are doubtful in the scan (e.g. 75, 141, 161 are rendered in a faded hand). Ink show-through and stains are present and were ignored.
